meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能作为 GitHub 机器人账号接入,处理 PR 和 Issue 评论串:被 @ 时回复,之后持续跟进该串后续评论。
howto.when: 当 webhook 收到 Issue 评论或 PR 审查评论,且评论里精确 @ bot 用户名时触发;首次 @ 后,同一评论串的后续评论也会触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 GitHub 频道,让 bot 在 PR 和 Issue 评论里回复。
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册依赖并配置 .env。

say.text: 给仓库 acme/backend 配置 GitHub 频道,按私库处理。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can act as a GitHub bot account. It participates in PR and issue comment threads, replying when @-mentioned. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed and it responds to all follow-up comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered by GitHub webhook events for issue comments and PR review comments when the comment exactly @-mentions the bot username. After the first mention, later comments in the same thread also trigger the agent.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel so the bot replies to PR and issue comments.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, registers the dependency, and sets .env.

say_en.text: Configure GitHub for repo acme/backend as a private repo.
say_en.note: It asks public/private and picks unknown_sender_policy.

say_en.text: Wire the GitHub bot to an agent group with per-thread sessions.
say_en.note: It runs ncl commands to complete the wiring.
